description: Authoritative source-of-truth for the business-rules workflow's parameterized gates. These values are deployed as Logic App settings via infra/params/*.bicepparam (businessRules parameter) -- edit them there for a real deployment. This file documents the same values in one human-readable place per the confirmed requirement that rules must be changeable via config, not code, and is also used by tests/ps-rule and local workflow authoring to keep expectations in sync with what Bicep deploys.

rules.description: Classification confidence below this threshold always routes to human review.
Configured high-risk document types always route to human review regardless of confidence.
If any mandatory extracted field is missing or empty, route to human review.

If a document hash already exists in Azure SQL, mark as duplicate and skip persistence. Evaluated by the Function (IngressProcessingFunction) before anything is queued, not by this workflow -- see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
rules.appSetting: n/a (Function-only; SHA-256 hash uniqueness enforced by dbo.IdempotencyLedger)

rules.description: If Document Intelligence reports zero pages/zero extracted content, route to failed/ with an alert. Evaluated by the Function before anything is queued, not by this workflow -- see docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md.

A review item unactioned after this many hours receives a reminder notification to the reviewer group. The stateful human-approval workflow uses a durable delay and then invokes the local SLA workflow.

A review item unactioned after this many hours escalates to the supervisor group through a durable delay and local SLA workflow invocation. Must be greater than ReviewReminder, and sasLinkExpiryHours must be >= this value so the escalated supervisor's document link has not already expired.

Hours a reviewer's read-only user-delegation SAS link stays valid. Must be >= ReviewEscalation. Capped at 168 because a user delegation key is valid for at most 7 days. The link only resolves from a VNet-connected endpoint -- see docs/runbook.md.

ownership.fallback: src/functions Services/DeterministicRoutingRuleEvaluator.cs computes the same ConfidenceGate/DocumentTypeGate/RequiredFieldsGate using identical app-setting values as a pre-routing signal and resiliency fallback only. The business-rules workflow re-evaluates authoritatively and its decision is what is persisted. Both evaluate DocumentTypeGate as EXACT array membership -- the workflow parses highRiskDocumentTypesJson into an array first rather than substring-matching the raw JSON string.
ownership.changeProcedure: Update the businessRules parameter in the relevant infra/params/<env>.bicepparam file and redeploy infra (no code or workflow-definition changes required). Update this file in the same pull request so the documented defaults stay in sync.
